name: angel
description: an Angel (Fall from Heaven), a blonde female warrior with long golden hair and a gold circlet, two big white feathered wings spread up behind her shoulders, shining gold plate armour (breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets, greaves and sabatons) over a short white skirt, a long straight steel sword with a gold crossguard in her RIGHT hand and a round gold shield on her LEFT arm
hands: the sword stays in her right hand on the screen-left side and the gold shield on her left arm on the screen-right side

strike.5: follow-through: the blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, long golden hair and white wings trailing back

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, white wings flaring, both arms jerk outward (sword arm thrown up and out to the left, the gold shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, sword dipping, the gold shield still held out, wings half folded

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, sword arm flung up, the gold shield drooping, wings flaring
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the sword slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the white wings crumpling
death.5: hits the ground: lying on her back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, her white wings spread flat on the ground under her; the sword lies on the ground at the lower-right; the gold shield lies flat beside her
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the wings settle, the gold shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on her back, eyes closed, white wings limp on the ground, the sword and the gold shield on the ground beside her
